protocol.hypothesis: M7 confirms complementary independent B/L classifiers, but hidden residual, attention and aligned interactions may still overfit. Existing normal-reference studies independently suppress each representation or concatenate PCA. Test whether normal-patient B/L shared crosscovariance directions allow a common representation while retaining more backbone-specific variation. Compare matched per-backbone independentPCA controls at same ranks. Crosscovariance SVD is an established principle, not a novel causal nuisance identifier.

Shared mode SVD of C_BL=A_B.T A_L/(Nnormal-1), using reducedQR and smallcoreSVD; left/right orthonormal directions eachbackbone. Rank8/32. Independently check spectrum via normalpatientGram square-root product, singular equations, centers, orthonormality and duplication invariance. No disease labels other than trainingnormal identification.
